items.title: California Wildfire Legislation Postponed, Utility Stocks Bounce
items.summary: A deal between Gov. Gavin Newsom and state legislators fell apart at the last minute. PG&E and Edison International recovered on the news, after plummeting on Monday.

items.title: PG&E, Edison Suffer Biggest Stock Drops in Years on California Wildfire Legislation
items.summary: Shares of publicly traded utilities tumbled today after an effort by California Gov. Gavin Newsom to shield the sector from wildfire-related lawsuits was rejected by state lawmakers.  California utility PG&E shares tumbled 20%, their biggest drop since the Covid-19 selloff of March 2020.  Other California-based utility stocks also sank, including Edison International.
